program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_in": (18.0, 10.0, 24.0),
    "L_in":    (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),
    "L_n":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "R1":      (250e3, 80e3, 600e3),
    "Iu2":     (0.8e-6, 0.4e-6, 0.85e-6),
    "gmid5":   (14.0, 8.0, 22.0),
    "L5":      (0.15, 0.15, 0.6),
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 6.0, 18.0),
    "L_p":     (0.3, 0.15, 1.0),
    "Wn_i1":   (0.84, 0.42, 2.0),
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, I, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.1, 1.6
    for _ in range(45):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < I:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def design(p, lut, spec):
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vod = abs(spec.get("vod", 0.01))
    cl = spec.get("cl", 50e-15)
    It = iref
    Iu2 = p["Iu2"]
    k = 3                                   # stage-2 mirror 1:3

    # stage-2 NMOS unit (pair M5b/M5, gates d1/o1) -> sets common Vgs
    L5 = p["L5"]
    s5 = lut.size("n", p["gmid5"], L5, Iu2, vds=0.9)
    W5 = max(0.42, s5.W)
    vg = _vgs_for(lut, "n", W5, L5, Iu2, 1.0)
    sc5 = W5 / max(s5.W, 1e-3)

    # stage-1 diode load M3/M4 sized so Vgs(It/2) == vg  -> balance o1 = d1 = vg
    Ln = p["L_n"]
    r_um = lut.op("n", 1.0, Ln, vg, vg)["Id"]
    W3 = max(0.42, (It / 2) / max(r_um, 1e-12))
    op3 = lut.op("n", W3, Ln, vg, vg)

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_in"], p["L_in"], It / 2, vds=0.6)

    # PMOS mirror unit
    Lp = p["L_p"]
    s7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Iu2, vds=0.8)
    Wp = max(0.42, s7.W)
    scp = Wp / max(s7.W, 1e-3)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MP1", "d1", "vinn", "ibias", "ibias", mp)
    n.dev("MP2", "o1", "vinp", "ibias", "ibias", mp)
    n.M("M3", "d1", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, Ln)
    n.M("M4", "o1", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W3, Ln)
    n.R("R1", "o1", "d1", p["R1"])
    # stage 2: differential NMOS (no tail), PMOS 1:k mirror
    n.M("M5B", "pb", "d1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, L5)
    n.M("M7", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    for i in range(k):
        n.M("M5_%d" % i, "o2", "o1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W5, L5)
        n.M("M6_%d" % i, "o2", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp, Lp)
    Wn1, Wp1 = p["Wn_i1"], 0.42
    Wn2, Wp2 = 1.0, 3.0
    n.M("MI1N", "o3", "o2", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn1, 0.15)
    n.M("MI1P", "o3", "o2", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp1, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2N", "vout", "o3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wn2, 0.15)
    n.M("MI2P", "vout", "o3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wp2, 0.15)

    # ---- delay model ----
    cox = 8.5e-15
    dI = mp.gm * vod
    gds4 = op3["gds"]
    Rout1 = 1.0 / (2.0 / p["R1"] + mp.gds + gds4)
    V1 = dI * Rout1
    c4dd = W3 * Ln * cox * 0.4 + W3 * 0.6e-15
    c5gg = s5.cgg * sc5
    c5gd = s5.cgd * sc5
    c5dd = s5.cdd * sc5
    c6dd = s7.cdd * scp
    C1 = mp.cdd + c4dd + k * c5gg + 0.5e-15
    Vx = 0.03
    t1 = Rout1 * C1 * math.log(2 * V1 / max(V1 - Vx, 0.2 * V1))
    frac = math.exp(-s5.gm_id * min(V1, 0.3))
    Inet = max(k * Iu2 * (1 - frac), 1e-8)
    c_i1 = (Wn1 + Wp1) * 0.15 * cox * 1.6
    Co2 = k * (c5dd + c6dd) + c_i1 + 0.5e-15
    t2 = Co2 * 0.8 / Inet
    tm = k * c5gd * 0.9 / max(dI / 2, 1e-9)
    c_i2 = (Wn2 + Wp2) * 0.15 * cox * 1.6
    t3 = c_i2 * 0.9 / 40e-6 + cl * 0.9 / 150e-6
    tpd = t1 + t2 + tm + t3

    power = 1.8 * (iref + (k + 1) * Iu2)
    return n, {"tpd": tpd, "power": power, "polarity_ok": 1,
               "gain1_db": db(max(mp.gm * Rout1, 1e-6))}
